summary.text: Daryl Schmitt is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 48 since September 2024 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He is a farmer who was appointed by the county Republican caucus to replace Mark Messmer.

paragraphs.text: Schmitt lives in southern Indiana and earned degrees from Vincennes University and Indiana State University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a fifth-generation farmer on a family farm and in seed sales.
He served on the Dubois County Council from January 2023 to September 2024.
Schmitt was appointed to the state Senate on September 4, 2024, and assumed office on September 10, 2024.
